# EnableMenu

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Menus](BlitzPlus-Menus)

</div>


```blitzbasic
EnableMenu menu:Int32
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `menu` | Int32 | required | Handle of a menu or item. |

## Description

Makes a menu item usable again after [DisableMenu](DisableMenu).

## Related Commands

[CheckMenu](CheckMenu), [CreateMenu](CreateMenu), [DisableMenu](DisableMenu), [MenuChecked](MenuChecked), [MenuEnabled](MenuEnabled), [MenuText](MenuText), [SetMenuText](SetMenuText), [UncheckMenu](UncheckMenu)
